name: k0-knowledge-inject
question: Does a budgeted k7e inject (## Knowledge, 2 KiB) let a member state a fact that lives only in its store — nowhere in prompt or history — without the control arm leaking?

arms.A: Knowledge: off — the codeword fact exists only in the (never read) store
arms.B: Knowledge: on (2 KiB) — the inject block is the only difference

predictions.claim: arm B states the codeword in >= 2/3 of trials (inject delivers usable facts through a small model, past 5 distractor entries)
arm A stays at the hallucination floor, <= 1/6 (the chassis does not leak the fact by any path but inject)
